messages:
Sam (CS): Aurora Logistics (acct AUR-55) pinged about INV-2026-08-5507. Their reseller partner applied a channel discount that should have reduced the gross charge but our system applied it as a downstream credit instead, leaving procurement confused. Can billing advise on whether to issue a correcting credit or reissue the invoice?

billing-bot: Invoice INV-2026-08-5507 generated 2026-08-05 08:30 UTC. Lines: RESERVED-ENTERPRISE (6 GPUs) 2026-08-01 - 2026-08-31 $12,600.00; Partner channel discount (applied as credit) -1,260.00; Usage $1,240.10; Total due $12,580.10. Note: Partner reported expected invoice subtotal to be $11,340.00 (i.e., 10% discount applied to reserved line before taxes).

Nina (PartnerOps): The reseller (LogiChannel) contract stipulates partner discounts must appear as a line-item discount on the invoice subtotal so procurement sees net pricing. Their onboarding note included: "apply 10% channel discount on reserved base per invoice." We mistakenly flagged the account to receive a separate credit memo instead (partner flow). They want a corrected invoice because their procurement won't accept credit memos for P.O. reconciliation.

Paul (Billing): Two options: (A) Reissue replacement invoice with line-level discount (invoice replacement), or (B) leave invoice and create a negative credit memo plus explanatory statement. Replacement invoices require voiding original and regenerating; that has tax and reporting implications — esp. for countries where replacement invoices must be marked. Need Finance and Legal check.

Rosa (Finance): Quick numbers: If discount applies to reserved base only, reserved net = 12,600 * 0.9 = 11,340. Usage remains 1,240.10. New total = 12,580.10 -> Wait, that equals current total? Looks like current invoice shows discount as credit but subtotal still reflects full reserved line making totals confusing for procurement because credit memos are separate. Aurora expects invoice to show reserved at 11,340 and total 12,580.10 with explanatory line. So amounts line up, but presentation differs. Procurement insists on replacement invoice that lists discounted reserved line. We should prefer replacement invoice to satisfy customer if tax/legal ok.

Liam (Legal): Replacement is allowed but we must ensure invoice numbering continuity and include a note: "Replacement invoice replacing INV-2026-08-5507 per partner discount presentation request." For VAT jurisdictions, replacing invoices can affect reporting; we need to tag tax-team and issue corrected invoice with credit reason. If totals don't change and the credit is purely presentation, a corrected invoice (not a refund) is fine. Need Finance ok.

Paul (Billing): Implementation details: create replacement INV-2026-08-5507-R with line: RESERVED-ENTERPRISE 11,340.00 (10% channel discount applied); Usage 1,240.10; Tax computed on net amounts. Void original or mark replaced. Create ledger note referencing CR-2026-08-330 (partner credit memo) that will be auto-applied then removed once replacement issued. I can run the replacement now if Finance approves.

Rosa (Finance): Approve replacement invoice since net amounts unchanged and customer procurement requires it. Approve up to $0 in cash movement. For tax: ensure tax team signs off on mark-as-replaced flag. If replacement triggers cross-period reporting issues, we'll route to accounting. Otherwise, proceed. Nina, confirm Aurora's billing address and tax jurisdiction so we can tag tax-team.

Nina (PartnerOps): Aurora billing address: UK (GB), VAT ID GB987654321. Procurement insists on replacement. I've attached their email. They also requested that the invoice include partner name and PO number. PO: PO-AL-8811.

Paul (Billing): Running replacement draft and tax calc. Quick snippet:
```
Original reserved: 12,600.00
Channel discount: 10% -> -1,260.00
Reserved net: 11,340.00
Usage: 1,240.10
Subtotal: 12,580.10
VAT (UK 20%): 2,516.02 (applied to subtotal)
Total replacement: 15,096.12
```
Note: Original invoice tax line was calculated on gross before credit application in presentation; replacement will compute tax on net reserved/usage which may change tax amount. Need UK tax confirmation.

Liam (Legal): Tagging tax-team required. If tax delta is non-zero, we may need to issue VAT adjustment and notify Aurora. Nina, confirm if Aurora wants us to bill VAT on net pricing (likely yes).

Paul (Billing): I checked: original invoice had VAT computed on net after credit (system did compute correctly) but display order confused procurement. Replacement invoice tax number matches original. Draft replacement ready; credit memo CR-2026-08-330 already created by system as part of partner flow; we'll mark it as removed once replacement issued to avoid double entries.

Rosa (Finance): Proceed. Approve creation of replacement invoice INV-2026-08-5507-R; ensure audit trail: reason = partner invoice presentation per contract; approver = Rosa (Finance); legal note attached. No cash refund.

Paul (Billing): Creating replacement invoice and marking original replaced. Ledger actions:
```
ReplacementInvoice: INV-2026-08-5507-R
Replaces: INV-2026-08-5507
Customer: AUR-55 (Aurora Logistics)
Amount: 15,096.12 GBP (includes VAT)
Reason: Partner discount presented on reserved line per reseller contract PO-AL-8811
CreatedBy: Paul (Billing)
```
Applied now. Removing provisional credit memo CR-2026-08-330 to avoid duplication.

billing-bot: Replacement invoice INV-2026-08-5507-R created 2026-08-05 14:20 UTC. Original INV-2026-08-5507 marked replaced. Credit memo CR-2026-08-330 voided. New invoice PDF available.

Nina (PartnerOps): I'll send Aurora the replacement invoice and include a short note explaining we replaced the invoice to reflect partner discount line item. Also include PO-AL-8811.

Sam (CS): Customer responded: procurement accepted replacement PDF and closed the loop. Thanks team. Please add a short internal note to prevent future partner-flow presentation issues: update partner onboarding checklist to enforce "line-level discount vs credit memo" preference.

Rosa (Finance): Noted. Adding ledger note and closing. Auditor memo: "Partner discount presentation corrected via replacement INV-2026-08-5507-R; no net cash movement; tax recalculated and verified; approvals: Rosa (Finance), Liam (Legal)."

Paul (Billing): Done. Closing thread.
